_comment: Modules reachable from the promotion/execution path that deliberately do not escalate to adversarial review. Every entry needs a reason. See scripts/check-promotion-surface.py.

tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/config: The engine-wide settings object, imported by most of maistro-core. It carries no promotion threshold and makes no acceptance decision; protecting it would escalate the majority of ordinary core diffs, which is how escalation stops meaning anything.
tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/http.p: The shared outbound HTTP client. Reached because the loop talks to a gateway, not because it decides anything about a candidate. Its own trust boundary is the outbound policy in maistro/security/, which does escalate.
tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/quota/: Token-cost accounting. It bounds what a run may spend; it cannot change whether a candidate is promoted or what score it receives.
Per-provider rate limits. Same reasoning as billing.py: a spend and pacing control, not an acceptance control.
Records token usage per provider per billing cycle. Reachable because every model call is metered; no promotion decision reads it.
tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/tools/: The shared ToolResult dataclass. A data carrier with no policy in it.
tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/types/: The shared exception hierarchy. Reached transitively by everything that raises.
